history.summary: Freehold D14 3BR (1,001 sqft) at $1.38M / $1,379 psf, 8 min from Aljunied EWL, in a small 1998 boutique block. Only 2 URA transactions and no median PSF mean appreciation and fair value are unverifiable — this is a thin-data boutique where liquidity is the central risk.
history.rating_rationale: Reasonable freehold quantum ($1.38M, deep band) and efficient-for-3BR sizing in maturing D14 Paya Lebar (airbase relocation catalyst) keep it off Avoid, but 2 transactions give no reliable appreciation read, the 1998 boutique is illiquid with a shallow buyer pool, and there is no median to anchor whether $1,379 psf is fair. Insufficient data for conviction either way — Neutral, low confidence.
